messages:
Tom H: Vendor picked up wrong cartons for RMA. 2x A100s (node gpu-node-43, gpu-node-77) stuck in carrier hold at SFO. Serial mismatch on manifest. Ticket VND-3321 open. Need plan to keep capacity.
Lina C: can you paste serials?
Tom H: 
```
node gpu-node-43 -> S/N: SN-A100-9172
node gpu-node-77 -> S/N: SN-A100-1145
```
Tom H: vendor says consignee mismatch, holding till docs verified :grimacing:
Raja P: escalate vendor-side, i'll take the ticket. Spares pool is 1x A100 in us-west-2 right now.
Olivia S: spare count confirmed: us-west-2=1, eu-west-1=2, ap-south-1=0. If we move one from eu to us it'll cost ~ $250 carrier + 24h transit.
Raja P: propose we rebalance: drain gpu-node-43 (low traffic window 02:00-04:00 PST) and failover workloads to node-77 + hot spare. I'll request cross-region transfer if approved.
Tom H: drain command for infra runbook:
```
infra-drain-node --node gpu-node-43 --reason "RMA swap - carrier hold" --schedule "02:00-03:00 PST"
rwctl tag node gpu-node-43 add:pending-rma
```
Lina C: add cost ok from infra budget? cc @finance-team :eyes:
Tom H: Finance sign-off received via DM, cost approved :white_check_mark:
rma-bot: Carrier update: HOLD at SFO - reason: consignee_mismatch. ETA next_update 48h. Tracking: TRK123456789
Raja P: I've escalated with vendor ops, asked for immediate reconsignment and manifest correction. Also requested depot photo/serial scan.
Olivia S: once swap confirmed i'll coordinate courier and update capacity plan. If transit >24h we spin up a g4 temporary node to keep latency SLOs.
Lina C: please add internal incident tag `gpu-rma-sfo-1769548123` and notify oncall.
Tom H: added tag and pinged @oncall. Will update thread when vendor provides proof-of-pickup or new tracking. Thanks all :thumbsup:
